hero.title: Do You Answer the Same? A 20-Question Love Quiz for Couples
hero.description: 20 questions about your story. You each answer on your own, then compare: how many times will you land on the same answer without discussing it?

howTo.title: How do you play?
howTo.step1: Enter your two first names. One phone is enough, put it between you.
howTo.step2: The first answers all 20 questions without showing the screen, then hands the phone over.
howTo.step3: The second answers the same questions, without knowing what the other picked.
howTo.step4: The game compares your two answers, question by question.
howTo.outro: There are no right answers here. The questions where you answered differently are the interesting ones: that's where there's something to talk about, and our 120 questions to ask each other take over once these run out.

seo.whyTitle: Why Take This Love Quiz Together?
seo.whySubtitle: A quiz designed to strengthen your bond and understand each other better.
seo.card1Text: Every statement is an opportunity for discussion. Express your feelings and listen to your partner's.
seo.card2Text: You each answer without seeing the other. At the end, the game puts your two answers side by side, question by question. Where the common points test looks for what you share, this one is about your own story.
seo.card3Text: Simply taking this quiz together shows your commitment to the relationship. That's already a proof of love!
seo.card4Text: Whatever your score, this quiz allows you to celebrate your story and remember why you're together.
seo.faq1Q: How is this love quiz played?
seo.faq1A: Two players, one phone. The first answers all 20 questions, hands the phone over, and the second answers the same ones. The game then compares your answers one by one.
seo.faq2Q: How long does the quiz take?
seo.faq2A: About ten minutes together. Nothing is timed, and the questions you want to talk about deserve the detour.
seo.faq3A: Yes, 100% free and no registration required. Your answers are not saved, you can retake the quiz as many times as you want.
seo.faq4A: The score counts the questions where you picked the same answer without discussing it. A low score says very little about your relationship; mostly it says you have things to tell each other.
